title: All About Nell
checkpoint: Reception Spring 1, week 4 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds ai, ee, igh
note_for_grown_ups: Non-fiction, Phase 3, 38-sound stage (ai, ee, igh just added). Simple true facts about bees, told through Nell.

pages.illustration: Close view of Nell, a bee with yellow and black stripes, perched on a sunflower.
Nell the bee hovering just above the sunflower, wings a blur.
Close view of Nell the bee's big round eyes, looking out over a garden wall.
Nell the bee flying high up above the garden wall, small against a bright blue sky.
Nell the bee resting on top of the warm garden wall in bright sunshine.

pages.text: Nell is wet in the rain.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee sheltering on the wall as raindrops fall around her, looking damp and unhappy.

pages.text: Nell sits. Nell waits a bit.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee tucked still against the wall, raindrops still falling but starting to ease.

pages.text: Nell is a bee. Nell can buzz. Nell has fun in the sun.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee flying happily above the wall again in bright sunshine, rain gone.
